Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses a complex TPP (Thermal Proteome Profiling) design combining a temperature range (TPP-TR) and a compound concentration range (TPP-CCR). The primary biological variables are the chemical treatment (prodigiosin) and the genetic knockout (GRASP55 KO). The TPP-TR part of the experiment specifically uses temperature as an analytical probe to determine protein stability, which is part of the MS assay method rather than a primary biological perturbation variable in the sense of a treatment group.
